name.full: Traycer Remote — approve and monitor agent runs from Teams

description.short: Approve, reject, and monitor Traycer agent runs from Teams.
description.full: Relays through the Traycer remote bridge to your own desktop host — browse the fleet, read a chat's transcript, and approve or reject pending actions without leaving Teams.

commands.title: fleet
commands.description: List the agents in this conversation's epic. Open a row to reply to it or read its history

commands.title: epics
commands.description: List your epics, so you can bind one to this conversation

commands.title: epic
commands.description: epic <id> — bind this conversation to an epic. Sent bare, replies with the id you need

commands.title: chat
commands.description: chat <id> — one agent's status, with any pending approval above the fold

commands.title: log
commands.description: log <id> — read an agent's transcript, a page at a time

commands.title: say
commands.description: say <id> <message> — message an agent. Omit the message for a compose box

commands.title: help
commands.description: Show every command with its syntax
